ctbids-49255-5750133.description:
This is an exquisite pair of antique English bone china teacups and matching saucers manufactured by the historic Mintons factory and commissioned exclusively for Tiffany & Co., New York.
This premium set dates between 1873 and 1912, capturing the peak luxury of the Gilded Age.
Both sets feature Pattern H1649, a high-end design distinguished by its heavy, encrusted gold scrollwork borders, beautifully scalloped rims, and a radiant gilded band running along the inner cup rims.
Tea cups bears the stamped gold Mintons crowned globe hallmark alongside the custom "Tiffany & Co. New York / Made in England" retailer mark.
Saucers bear stamped gold Mintons crowned hallmark alongside "Davis Collamore & Co. / FIFTH AVE & 37TH ST/ NEW YORK."

281294240.description:
Natural Selenite Crystal
Carved Skyscraper Tower Point
White Satin Spar Gypsum, Approximately 8.5-9 Inches Tall
Carved natural selenite crystal tower sculpted in an architectural stepped skyscraper formation. Selenite, a crystalline variety of gypsum prized for its fibrous formation and luminous optical chatoyancy, is a staple in mineral collecting, energy practices, and contemporary interior decor. This substantial display specimen showcases translucent columnar layers that reflect and diffuse ambient light throughout its tiered structure.
Sculpted from natural white satin spar selenite with linear crystalline striations
Distinctive multi-tiered skyscraper silhouette tapering to a faceted peak
Flat, unpolished saw-cut base ensuring stable freestanding tabletop display
Measures approximately 8.5 to 9 inches tall by 3.25 to 3.5 inches in base diameter
Condition:
Very good condition. Presents characteristic natural mineral features including internal cleavage planes, layered textures, and minor edge roughness typical of hand-carved soft gypsum crystal. The cut base is structurally sound and stands firmly upright.
